name: Onam
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Onam is a biblical figure mentioned in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Jerahmeel and his wife Atara, and belonged to the tribe of Judah. He is primarily known through genealogical lists that link him to the descendants of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Onam's Birth and Lineage
keyEvents.description: Onam is mentioned as the son of Jerahmeel by his second wife Atara, in the genealogy of Judah's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Jerahmeel's Descendants
keyEvents.description: Onam is part of the detailed genealogy tracing the descendants of Jerahmeel, son of Hezron, in the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Onam's Sons
keyEvents.description: Onam's sons Shammai and Jada are mentioned in the genealogy, showing that his lineage continued within the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Hezron's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Onam is included in the broader lineage from Hezron, who was an important branch of the tribe of Judah and ancestor to many prominent Israelites.

keyEvents.title: Onam in Seir's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Another name, Onam, also appears as the son of Shobal, a Horite from the land of Seir, in the genealogy of Genesis.
